label: Charge / Coordinator
mission: Run a shift where nobody is left alone with something they cannot carry — including me.
sub: Devon Marsh, RN · charge, 32-bed med-surg · nights · nine years in · two new grads on the floor most weeks.
values: Leave the shift better than I found it
seasonBody: Two new grads and a thin float pool. You decided in June that this season is about making the night shift survivable rather than heroic, and you wrote down what that means.
seasonMeta: Month 3 of 6 · 2 new grads active · next review 1 November

actions.title: Finish the assignment-fairness draft
actions.why: Three nurses have raised the same pattern about weekend acuity. You have the data in your own notes and a draft two-thirds written; the next huddle is the moment it is useful.
actions.cost: 20 minutes · Scribe has your notes staged

actions.title: Debrief last Thursday's escalation
actions.why: It went well, which is exactly why it never gets debriefed. The new grad who called it should hear that she called it correctly.
actions.cost: 10 minutes · no PHI in the note

actions.title: Take the break you assign everyone else
actions.why: You covered four breaks last stretch and took none. The pattern is visible in your own logs, not in anyone's complaint.

health.signal: Four breaks covered for others last stretch, none taken.
health.detail: You are the only person on the floor whose break nobody assigns. Noticed, not judged — but it is the third stretch running.

family.signal: Standing Saturday breakfast held seven of eight weeks.
family.detail: The one fixture nights have not taken. Worth defending as hard as the schedule.

career.signal: Two new grads through orientation. Zero escalation misses this quarter.
career.detail: The season's actual scoreboard, and it is good. Your license and standing are held separately, above.

learning.signal: CE hours 19 of 30. Charge-nurse leadership module half done.
learning.detail: On pace without effort. Nothing dated is at risk this cycle.

finance.detail: Checked in July and correct. Nothing here needs your attention.

creative.signal: Three process drafts. One adopted by day shift.
creative.detail: Your handoff tightening is now running on days too. That is influence without a title.

service.signal: Two new grads mentored weekly. Never once rescheduled.
service.detail: The highest-leverage line on this screen and it is fully tended. Consistency is the whole intervention.

business.signal: Nothing here, on purpose, this season.
business.detail: Correctly empty. The system will not invent work for a domain you have deliberately left alone.

momentum.label: returned to you this quarter — huddle prep, assignment drafts, escalation notes, and debriefs you no longer write from nothing.
momentum.note: Estimated from your own logged times. Nothing here reads a staffing system, and nothing is reported to one.
momentum.caption: huddle prep stopped eating the first hour in week 5

reputation.name: Published
reputation.meta: 1 process note carries your name · reviewed by you · 0 auto-sent

reputation.name: Sent to staff
reputation.meta: 0 messages to the unit have left this system unreviewed

risks.what: Assignment context typed into a prompt
risks.guard: Acuity, room, and patient context are employer data and patient data at once. Import refuses on identifier patterns and the nightly lint sweeps what is stored. The system catches it.
Refused at every tier, in every sphere, including Green. The system catches it.

risks.what: Reaching for an ungoverned window instead
risks.guard: No governed system can reach a chat window it does not run. This one is yours to keep — it is the reason the rails are worth having.

license.scopeNote: Running the floor does not raise your agent's ceiling. Charge authority is authority over an assignment, not over a gate. The agent drafts the fairness note; you send it.

signals.title: Three stretches without taking your own break
signals.body: You covered four for other people. Noticed, not judged — and visible only in your own logs.

signals.title: The fairness draft has been two-thirds written for nine days
signals.body: Three nurses raised the same pattern. The draft is the reply; it needs finishing, not more evidence.

signals.title: Zero escalation misses this quarter
signals.body: Across two new grads and a thin float pool. Worth logging before the quarter closes and it becomes background.

signals.title: Six library pages predate the handoff change
signals.body: Stale process notes are worse than none — they are confidently out of date.

opps.title: Day shift asked for your handoff draft
opps.body: They adopted the first version unprompted. The second one could be written jointly.

opps.title: Charge leadership module, half complete
opps.body: Four of eight done. The remaining four are the ones that count toward your CE cycle.

opps.title: Your July new grad wants to precept
opps.body: She asked in August. Your notes say you meant to talk to the educator.

opps.title: The escalation debrief template is reusable
opps.body: No PHI, no employer content. It would sanitize in one pass.

agents.name: Florence
agents.scope: All spheres, read-only outside Health. Drafts freely; sends nothing.

agents.name: Scholar
agents.scope: Learning sphere only. Reads public material and your own notes.

agents.name: Scribe
agents.scope: Creativity and Career spheres. No roster, no staffing system, no outbound send.
